title: Sustainable extraction of bioactive compounds: a life cycle perspective on technologies, solvents, and process scale-up
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00832H, Critical Review

LCA reveals trade-offs in bioactive compound extraction. Solvent choice affects yield and impact. Process simulation enables LCA-based scale-up. Waste valorization improves sustainability. Life cycle thinking supports feasible green extraction.
